scope: W5 end-to-end acceptance for the wiki-native work order: AgentVersion-published WikiBinding, run-frozen resolution, and the native query_wiki tool delivering the unified RAW/WIKI_DERIVED evidence envelope through a real agent run.

corpus.note: All sources are ingested BEFORE wiki compilation; query_wiki's raw retriever is snapshot-scoped by design. Group C revokes both isolation sources.

sampling_discipline.source: work order W5: engineering milestone, model calls concentrated here, <=200 total
sampling_discipline.sample: 50 questions = 20 pure-wiki (group A) + 20 hybrid-required (group B) + 10 post-revocation refusal (group C); ~2 gateway calls per A/B run, 0 calls for structural C refusals, ~6-8 wiki compile calls, 2 calls for the one frozen-run continuation demo

A_pure_wiki.expectation: agent run calls query_wiki; delivered evidence labelled WIKI_DERIVED; final answer cites delivered short ids
gates: citation validity 100% of [n] markers resolve to delivered view ids

descriptive SQuAD token F1 reported against preregistered gold, compared descriptively with the frozen independent-API WIKI-mode answers of docs/wiki/live-result-20261025.json (no new experimental gate)

B_hybrid_required.expectation: questions combine facts across sources; the harness system prompt instructs the agent to call query_wiki with mode=HYBRID for synthesis questions, which forces both the wiki and the snapshot-scoped raw retriever; every delivered item is origin-labelled
gates: origin labels 100% correct across all delivered items (structural, database adjudication)
dual-layer delivery rate reported: fraction of B runs whose delivered evidence contains both RAW and WIKI_DERIVED; preregistered expectation >=80%, deviations reported with causes

C_revoked_refusal.expectation: after tombstoning one source revision, every attempt to answer is refused
gates: refusal rate 100%: 10/10 new runs refused at creation with WIKI_PUBLICATION_REVOKED (work order W3-3); plus one pre-revocation prepared run demonstrated separately as the frozen-run tool-level fail-closed path (WIKI_BINDING_INVALID tool error, answer must not quote the revoked source)

comparison.baseline: docs/wiki/live-result-20261025.json (independent Wiki API, 6 cases, WIKI/RAG/HYBRID, 23 gateway calls, build 9beb449) reused frozen as the descriptive historical baseline; no re-run
comparison.usage: group A descriptive F1 vs that run's WIKI-mode answers; same-corpus, different question sets, therefore descriptive only

zero_api_gates: fresh-database migration 0001->0034 applies (verified 2026-10-25 on scratch DB agenthub_w2_migration_check / agenthub_w4_native_tool)
full unit suite green; full integration suite green on a fresh PostgreSQL database (288-targeted + new binding/run/tool groups)
structural origin check: every delivered item's origin decidable against the database
hard_gates: citation validity 100% across groups A and B
origin-label correctness 100% across groups A and B
questions: questions.json (50 entries, frozen before first model call; group C reuses A-style questions whose answers live in the to-be-revoked source)
abort_rules: gateway calls exceed 200 -> abort, report partial

agent_configuration.system_prompt: Answer from the published knowledge using the query_wiki tool. For questions that ask you to combine, compare, or synthesize multiple facts, call query_wiki with mode=HYBRID. Cite evidence using its short id in square brackets.
agent_configuration.disclosure: the synthesis instruction is harness configuration, preregistered here; it is not a code path

amendments.at: 2026-10-25 (before first successful compile; ~10 gateway calls spent on failed compiles)
amendments.change: corpus v2: split constraints-basics and isolation-basics into smaller sources; group C revokes isolation-levels and isolation-rc; group A/B question text unchanged
amendments.reason: repeated WIKI_COMPILER_INVALID_OUTPUT with finish_reason=length (model output truncated at the frozen 4096-token ceiling on the large single-source chunks); smaller sources reduce per-chunk output

amendments.at: 2026-10-25 (before first successful compile; ~15 gateway calls spent on failed compiles)
amendments.change: compiler plan max_tokens 4096 -> 8192; corpus unchanged from v2; question set unchanged
amendments.reason: per-chunk extraction output measured at up to 4069 tokens with finish_reason=stop; the 4096 ceiling truncated long outputs mid-JSON. Environment knob only, no algorithm or contract change.
